label: t22 = t20 plus the fourth genome-scale source, HEK293T from X-Atlas/Orion, at equal weight (K562, CD4, HCT116, HEK293T; shrunk effects, gamma 1, amplitude 1.576, cis head as t20); trial-01 generator
claim_type: prediction registered before generation and submission; not a measurement

recipe.cache: stage 98 run r5 (r4 plus orion_hek293t; k562, cd4_* and orion_hct116 byte-identical to r4)

one_factor: against t20 only the source set changes (HEK293T added at weight 1); amplitude, shrinkage, gamma and cis head are t20's
evidence_used: reports/quattro_sorgenti_2026-09-26/ r1, rule fixed at 15:30 before the bench: adding HEK293T at weight 1 to the recipe's other inputs moves 0.36 dPDS_gen - 0.27 dnMAE_gen by +0.011 (+0.006..+0.016) with K562 held out and +0.001 (-0.006..+0.009) with CD4 held out; nMAE proxy -0.011 and -0.022 (intervals below zero), PDS proxy through the generator +0.023 and -0.013. Measured on the built effects: at the same amplitude t22 moves about 30% fewer detectable genes than t20 (A 295 -> 208, B 369 -> 266, C 414 -> 300; 4 / sqrt(400 mu) at >= 5 CPM), energy 0.88x, per-target correlation with t20 median 0.86. The official t17 (t15 plus HEK293T at equal weights, another amplitude) read +0.0012 against t15, inconclusive. The generator uses one random stream: t22 - t20 carries generator noise of unknown size.

reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.t22 >= t20 + 0.005: HEK293T enters the reference: the four genome-scale sources become the default pool for the final set, and their genome-wide universes are the priority data
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.t22 <= t20 - 0.005: HEK293T leaves the reference; examine reach and Jaccard first (30% fewer detectable genes at the same amplitude) against PDS; the next test is the four-source pool at t20's detectable genes
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.otherwise: inconclusive within resolution (the expected case): t20 stays the reference for attribution; the four-source pool stays the plan for the final set's coverage, with its amplitude recalibrated at matched detectable genes before it is used
